lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to take the whole army to Ai, and Joshua sends 30,000 mighty men out at night.
The ambush lies in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the east of Ai, while Joshua's main camp is north of the city.
Israel flees toward the wilderness, and every man of Ai and Bethel leaves the city to chase them.
Joshua holds out his staff toward Ai, and the men in ambush rise, enter the city, capture it and set it on fire.
Joshua burns Ai into a permanent heap of ruins and raises a large pile of rocks over the body of its king.
